name: rocketride
description: Build, check and run RocketRide data and AI pipelines, and read each run's logs and traces. Also deploy pipelines, set their schedules and read files in your account's file store. Connect to the hosted server at https://api.rocketride.ai/mcp with your RocketRide account, so there is nothing to install. A self-hosted RocketRide engine runs the same MCP server.
